mapper.insert: INSERT INTO faq_entry (question, answer, keywords, category, source_doc, heading_path, hit_count, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{question}, #{answer}, #{keywords}, #{category}, #{sourceDoc}, #{headingPath}, 0, 'active', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE faq_entry SET question = #{question}, answer = #{answer}, keywords = #{keywords}, category = #{category}, source_doc = #{sourceDoc}, heading_path = #{headingPath}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM faq_entry WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY hit_count DESC
SELECT * FROM faq_entry WHERE category = #{category} AND status = 'active' ORDER BY hit_count DESC
SELECT * FROM faq_entry WHERE status = 'active' AND (question ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR keywords ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY hit_count DESC
SELECT * FROM faq_entry WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY hit_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE faq_entry SET hit_count = hit_count + 1, last_hit_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: UPDATE faq_entry SET status = 'deleted', update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE faq_entry SET category = #{category}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id IN #{id}
UPDATE faq_entry SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id IN #{id}
UPDATE faq_entry SET status = 'deleted', update_time = NOW() WHERE id IN #{id}
UPDATE faq_entry SET hit_count = hit_count + 1, last_hit_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM faq_entry WHERE id IN #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faq_entry WHERE last_hit_time >= CURRENT_DATE

SELECT TO_CHAR(d.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, COALESCE(COUNT(f.id), 0) AS cnt FROM generate_series(CURRENT_DATE - (#{days} - 1), CURRENT_DATE, '1 day'::interval) d(date) LEFT JOIN faq_entry f ON DATE(f.last_hit_time) = d.date GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date
SELECT category, SUM(hit_count) AS total_hits FROM faq_entry WHERE status = 'active' AND category IS NOT NULL AND category != '' GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_hits DESC
